legend: Yet another round on DecoForces is coming! Grandpa Maks wanted to participate in it but someone has stolen his precious sofa! And how can one perform well with such a major loss?
Fortunately, the thief had left a note for Grandpa Maks. This note got Maks to the sofa storehouse. Still he had no idea which sofa belongs to him as they all looked the same!
The storehouse is represented as matrix n × m. Every sofa takes two neighbouring by some side cells. No cell is covered by more than one sofa. There can be empty cells.

Sofa A is standing to the left of sofa B if there exist two such cells a and b that xa < xb, a is covered by A and b is covered by B. Sofa A is standing to the top of sofa B if there exist two such cells a and b that ya < yb, a is covered by A and b is covered by B. Right and bottom conditions are declared the same way.
Note that in all conditions A ≠ B. Also some sofa A can be both to the top of another sofa B and to the bottom of it. The same is for left and right conditions.
The note also stated that there are cntl sofas to the left of Grandpa Maks's sofa, cntr — to the right, cntt — to the top and cntb — to the bottom.
Grandpa Maks asks you to help him to identify his sofa. It is guaranteed that there is no more than one sofa of given conditions.
Output the number of Grandpa Maks's sofa. If there is no such sofa that all the conditions are met for it then output -1.
input: The first line contains one integer number d (1 ≤ d ≤ 105) — the number of sofas in the storehouse.
The second line contains two integer numbers n, m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 105) — the size of the storehouse.

Next d lines contains four integer numbers x1, y1, x2, y2 (1 ≤ x1, x2 ≤ n, 1 ≤ y1, y2 ≤ m) — coordinates of the i-th sofa. It is guaranteed that cells (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) have common side, (x1, y1)  ≠  (x2, y2) and no cell is covered by more than one sofa.
The last line contains four integer numbers cntl, cntr, cntt, cntb (0 ≤ cntl, cntr, cntt, cntb ≤ d - 1).
output: Print the number of the sofa for which all the conditions are met. Sofas are numbered 1 through d as given in input. If there is no such sofa then print -1.
note: The first sofa has 0 to its left, 2 sofas to its right ((1, 1) is to the left of both (5, 5) and (5, 4)), 0 to its top and 2 to its bottom (both 2nd and 3rd sofas are below).
The second sofa has cntl = 2, cntr = 1, cntt = 2 and cntb = 0.
The third sofa has cntl = 2, cntr = 1, cntt = 1 and cntb = 1.
So the second one corresponds to the given conditions.
The first sofa has cntl = 1, cntr = 1, cntt = 0 and cntb = 1.
The second sofa has cntl = 1, cntr = 1, cntt = 1 and cntb = 0.
And there is no sofa with the set (1, 0, 0, 0) so the answer is -1.

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 d（1 ≤ d ≤ 10^5）——仓库中沙发的数量。
第二行包含两个整数 n、m（1 ≤ n，m ≤ 10^5）——仓库的大小。
接下来的 d 行中，每行包含四个整数 x1、y1、x2、y2（1 ≤ x1、x2 ≤ n，1 ≤ y1、y2 ≤ m）——第 i 张沙发的坐标。保证单元格 (x1，y1) 和 (x2，y2) 具有公共边，(x1，y1) ≠ (x2，y2)，并且没有任何单元格被多于一张沙发覆盖。
最后一行包含四个整数 cntl、cntr、cntt、cntb（0 ≤ cntl、cntr、cntt、cntb ≤ d - 1）。

output.ai: 输出满足所有条件的沙发编号。输入中沙发的编号为 1 到 d。如果不存在这样的沙发，则输出 -1。

note.ai: 让我们来看第二个样例。
第一张沙发左边有 0 张沙发，右边有 2 张沙发（(1, 1) 位于 (5, 5) 和 (5, 4) 的左侧），上方有 0 张沙发，下方有 2 张沙发（第 2 张和第 3 张沙发都在其下方）。
因此第二个符合给定条件。
第一个沙发的 cntl = 1、cntr = 1、cntt = 0 且 cntb = 1。
第二个沙发的 cntl = 1、cntr = 1、cntt = 1 且 cntb = 0。
并且不存在集合为 (1, 0, 0, 0) 的沙发，因此答案是 -1。

legend.ai: 又一轮 DecoForces 比赛即将开始！马克斯爷爷本想参加，但有人偷走了他珍贵的沙发！遭受如此重大的损失后，他又怎么能发挥出色呢？
幸运的是，小偷给马克斯爷爷留下了一张纸条。这张纸条把马克斯带到了沙发仓库。然而，他仍然不知道哪张沙发属于自己，因为它们看起来全都一样！
仓库用一个 n × m 的矩阵表示。每张沙发占据两个有公共边的相邻单元格。没有任何单元格会被多于一张沙发覆盖。仓库中可以存在空单元格。
如果存在两个这样的单元格 a 和 b，满足 xa < xb，且 a 被沙发 A 覆盖、b 被沙发 B 覆盖，则称沙发 A 位于沙发 B 的左侧。如果存在两个这样的单元格 a 和 b，满足 ya < yb，且 a 被沙发 A 覆盖、b 被沙发 B 覆盖，则称沙发 A 位于沙发 B 的上方。右侧和下方的条件定义方式相同。
注意，在所有条件中 A ≠ B。此外，某张沙发 A 既可能位于另一张沙发 B 的上方，也可能位于它的下方。左侧和右侧的条件同理。
注释还说明，Maks爷爷的沙发左边有 cntl 张沙发，右边有 cntr 张沙发，上方有 cntt 张沙发，下方有 cntb 张沙发。
Maks爷爷请你帮助他确定他的沙发。保证满足给定条件的沙发至多有一张。
输出Maks爷爷的沙发编号。如果不存在满足全部条件的沙发，则输出 -1。
